terrace_revision.issue: Current native 960x540 hero's smooth triangle dominates sparse, near-linear cliff strokes. The original painting's dark nested hill-backs and crowded hemp-fibre texture are missing.

source_interpretation.macro: Interlocking, overlapping hill-backs with changing curvature and broad blank gullies; secondary crests descend from a single mountain parent.
source_interpretation.meso: Three non-identical loaded curved backs, opposite turns, short grouped alum-head cap shadows and two unequal hemp-fibre concentrations on each parent.
source_interpretation.micro: Width-modulated pigment belly, thin dry tails, 40 source-oriented attached fibres and intentionally unmarked midstation gaps.

rounded_mass_revision.artcraft_skill: ArtCraft v9.1, reference-led structural study and material study
rounded_mass_revision.source: Huang Gongwang, Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains (c.1350), National Palace Museum, Smarthistory close-up; source pixels remain external

observations.macro: The source mountain crown is an irregular rounded saddle with connected rock tiers, not a single long regular triangle.
observations.meso: Interlocking rock cheek planes contain short alum-head lobes and recessed eroded folds. Subordinate faces should connect to real mountain bones.
observations.micro: Ink underpainting carries a load gradient, stronger dark clusters by ledges, dry-fibre attenuation and deliberately unpainted paper gaps.

candidate.contour: Middle mountain ridge nodes changed from one narrow apex to twenty-five individually positioned shoulder/summit/saddle nodes, with original Catmull interpolation and seeded fracture retained.
candidate.attachments: 3 positive face masses attach to stations 0.12/0.31/0.55 along the hero's real quadratic bone; 2 alum-head pressure caps per mass and 3 erosion grooves per mass attach at sampled face geometry.
candidate.material: Each mass uses a unique scoped multi-stop gradient with irregular five-cubic outer boundary, root-dark/wet to depleted dry tail.
candidate.preservation: Original ridge depth bands, 3 cubic back contours, 6 terrace caps, 40 hemp fibres, 24 pima fibres, pine grove, bamboo and film clock remain.
candidate.intended_negative_space: Paper above actual crest, through the gaps between the three landform masses, and in the undersides of the gradated shapes.

quality_gates.topology: 3 finite supported mass roots, 6 attached caps and 9 erosion children; no mass at detail 0; all gradients id-scoped across adjacent Storybook stages
quality_gates.flow: No two sides identical, 25 summit/shoulder nodes, triple ink mass alternates sides and has multi-curved outer contour
quality_gates.rhythm: Reviewer must see three distinct positive rock zones and natural broad voids without repeated oval scallops
quality_gates.material: 4 gradient stops per mass, varying cap weights and locally bounded erosion pressure
quality_gates.visual: Reject artificial rubber-stamp lobes and schematic stringy dark ribs even if tests pass; inspect native 960x540 and enlarged aligned 1.75x, 2.4x, 3.45x crops.
quality_gates.release_state: draft; awaits independent exact-head native visual review

face_hemp_revision.feature: 33 individual source-oriented ink fibre gestures, clipped within three original parent cheek volumes
face_hemp_revision.technique: long-hemp and lifted ink, Huang Gongwang c.1350, National Palace Museum, source technique guidance not traced
face_hemp_revision.hierarchy: ridge crest > quadratic rock bone > positive stone face > clipped curved face boundary > 14/11/8 independent tip-pressure strokes
face_hemp_revision.dry_wet: 6 or more selectively depleted parent-local strokes among dark and dilute clusters, two concentration windows separated by paper
face_hemp_revision.linework: rockLoadedRibbon 14 pressure stations with curvature, load/tip asymmetry, nominal width 0.46-1.7 stage units, no disconnected decals
face_hemp_revision.no_copy: All curve geometry and textures hand authored, keyed to parent shape and time frame; no source image pixels imported.
face_hemp_revision.rejection: Reject fine parallel rain or combs, repeated starburst marks or flat topological stickers even with structural tests passing.
